definitions.gloss: future blessing; good fortune that will come later (on an omikuji)
definitions.explanation: A fortune level on an {御神籤|おみくじ} meaning that good luck lies ahead rather than now — a sign to be patient. It is one of the lower-ranking blessings.

examples.japanese: おみくじ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{末吉|すえきち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: I drew a future blessing on the omikuji.

examples.japanese: {末吉|すえきち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧だ⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧だ。
examples.english: A future blessing means that now is a time for patience.

examples.japanese: {末吉|すえきち}だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦がっかりした→がっかりする：21758_gakkarisuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてあって→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}した→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧。
examples.english: I was a little disappointed to get a future blessing, but it said my luck would improve from now on, which reassured me.

notes:
A lower-ranking fortune on an おみくじ meaning that good luck will come in time rather than right away — a cue to be patient. ⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧ means "end" or "later," so the blessing (⟦{吉|きち}→吉：19344_kichi⟧) is one that arrives eventually.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {末吉|すえきち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw a future blessing
- {末吉|すえきち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to get a future blessing
